slides.heading: RAW vs Compressed
slides.subheading: Use RAW for maximum control — compressed for speed.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
bullets: RAW captures maximum sensor data; compressed formats save space.
It matters because workflow and storage change dramatically.
RAW gives flexibility but requires heavy processing.

slides.heading: Visual Guide
slides.caption: RAW gives flexibility but requires heavy processing.

slides.heading: How To
steps: Use RAW for high-end or cinematic work.
Use compressed for social content or fast edits.
Match codec to your editing machine.

slides.heading: Pro Tip
slides.text: ProRes RAW or BRAW offer a strong balance of flexibility and workflow.

slides.heading: Common Mistake
slides.text: Overshooting RAW without enough storage or processing power.
